summary: Parliament's Finance Committee reviewed the Chief Justice's pay, which Parliament sets under Article 102 of the Constitution. Because the Chief Justice and the Speaker of Parliament are treated as posts of the same rank, the committee proposed matching the Chief Justice's pay to the Speaker's newly revised pay by adding a special allowance.
keyPoints: Chief Justice currently receives MVR 91,000 a month in pay and allowances, the same as the Deputy Speaker
A MVR 4,125 monthly special allowance raises the total to MVR 95,125, matching the Speaker's revised pay
Estimated extra cost is MVR 49,500 a year
The committee agreed unanimously at its 26th meeting on 27 October 2026; the change applies from the day Parliament passes the report
outcome: Passed by Parliament on 28 October 2026 (40 yes, 12 no)
